title: Practice 8: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Хмурая погода ___ (наводить / навести — to introduce, bring, produce, make, cause) на него тоску.

exercises.context: навести́** — **наводи́ть — to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply.

exercises.q: Дверь отворилась, и ___ (взойти / всходить — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend) Тата, одна.

exercises.context: взойти́** — **всходи́ть — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body).
